mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over a 3-month window indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting central bank rate cuts and reducing corporate earnings growth expectations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates a weakening consumer demand environment, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units over the past month indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces consumer wealth and investment activity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates a broad-based supply-side disruption, which increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During recessionary periods (GDPC1 decline in two consecutive quarters), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening economic conditions, which triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline in two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 declines in two consecutive quarters and INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.
